checksums.description: Primary copy checksum: word-wise LE sum of save bytes [0, 0xA30), stored as u32 LE at 0xA30. Computed by FUN_08035c94 (0x28c words) and verified in FUN_08035d48 against *(param_2 + 0xA30).
checksums.name: copy0_checksum

checksums.description: Backup copy checksum: word-wise LE sum of save bytes [0xA34, 0xA34+0xA30), stored as u32 LE at 0xA34+0xA30 (0x1464). Same FUN_08035c94 formula; both copies written by the 2-iteration loop in FUN_08035dd8.
checksums.name: copy1_checksum

fields.description: Per-course state bytes, one per course id (169 entries). FUN_08035dd8 ORs bit 0x10 into every entry at init and clears it for ROM-table entries whose type word is 4; FUN_0801e384 ORs caller-supplied bits (init calls use bit 1 for courses 0, 0x19, 0x23, visible as 0x11 in baseline).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1292-1306 (init |=0x10 loop over 0xA9 bytes at save+0xF9, selective &~0x10); FUN_0801e384 line 622 (*(save+0xF9+course) |= bits); init calls FUN_0801e384(0,1),(0x19,1),(0x23,1) match baseline bytes 0xF9/0x112/0x11C=0x11.
fields.name: course_flags

fields.description: Mirror of course_flags in backup copy at 0xA34 (byte-identical in baseline.sav; both copies written by the 2-iteration SRAM write loop in FUN_08035dd8).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1314-1321 (writes the whole save image twice to SRAM 0x0E000000 with stride); baseline.sav bytes [0xB2D,0xBD6) equal bytes [0xF9,0x1A2).
fields.name: course_flags_mirror

fields.description: Course ids recorded as cleared, appended by FUN_0801e384 at save+0x24B+count. Baseline holds [0x00,0x19,0x23] matching the three init calls; capacity 169 ends exactly where cleared_list_count sits at 0x2F4.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801e384 line 639 (*(save+0x24B+count) = course); init calls FUN_0801e384(0,1),(0x19,1),(0x23,1) match baseline bytes at 0x24B-0x24D.
fields.name: cleared_course_ids

fields.description: Mirror of cleared_course_ids in backup copy at 0xA34 (byte-identical in baseline.sav).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1314-1321 (dual-copy SRAM write loop); baseline.sav bytes [0xC7F,0xD28) equal bytes [0x24B,0x2F4).
fields.name: cleared_course_ids_mirror

fields.description: Number of entries in cleared_course_ids, incremented by FUN_0801e384 on each record (append path is guarded by course id < 0x80). Baseline value 3 matches the three init records.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801e384 lines 638-640 (u16 count at save+0x2F4, count++ after each append; append guarded by param_1 < 0x80); baseline u16 at 0x2F4 is 3.
fields.name: cleared_list_count

fields.description: Mirror of cleared_list_count in backup copy at 0xA34 (baseline value 3, identical to primary).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1314-1321 (dual-copy SRAM write loop); baseline.sav u16 at 0xD28 is 3.
fields.name: cleared_list_count_mirror

fields.description: Status bits byte: set to 1 by save init; FUN_0801e384 ORs in bit 1 (value 2) when the recorded course has the 0x11 marker. Baseline value 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 line 1290 (save+0x1A = 1); FUN_0801e384 line 643 (*(save+0x1A) |= 2); baseline byte at 0x1A is 1.
fields.name: status_bits

fields.description: Mirror of status_bits in backup copy at 0xA34 (baseline value 1, identical to primary).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1314-1321 (dual-copy SRAM write loop); baseline.sav byte at 0xA4E is 1.
fields.name: status_bits_mirror

fields.description: 32 fixed records of 8 bytes (7 bytes copied from a ROM table plus a 0x5F terminator each). Baseline shows incrementing id patterns (01..09, 01 00.., 02 00..) consistent with a parts/course catalog initialized from ROM.
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1224-1239 (32-iteration loop copying 7 bytes from ROM table at save+0x2F8+i*8 then storing 0x5F); baseline bytes [0x2F8,0x3F8) show the 8-byte stride pattern.
fields.name: catalog_entries

fields.description: Mirror of catalog_entries in backup copy at 0xA34 (byte-identical in baseline.sav).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1314-1321 (dual-copy SRAM write loop); baseline.sav bytes [0xD2C,0xE2C) equal bytes [0x2F8,0x3F8).
fields.name: catalog_entries_mirror

fields.description: 32-bit word at save+8, zeroed by save init; purpose not yet traced to a gameplay caller (baseline value 0).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 line 1289 (*(save+8) = 0); baseline u32 at 0x08 is 0.
fields.name: init_zero_word

fields.description: Mirror of init_zero_word in backup copy at 0xA34 (baseline value 0, identical to primary).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1314-1321 (dual-copy SRAM write loop); baseline.sav u32 at 0xA3C is 0.
fields.name: init_zero_word_mirror

fields.description: Ten state bytes set to 0xFF by save init and partially consumed by gameplay (baseline keeps 0xFF only at 0x0E with 0x0F at 0x15).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1256-1265 (ten 0xFF bytes at save+0x0C..save+0x15); baseline bytes [0x0C,0x16) are 00 00 FF 00 00 00 00 00 00 0F.
fields.name: state_flags_0c

fields.description: Mirror of state_flags_0c in backup copy at 0xA34 (byte-identical in baseline.sav).
fields.evidence: FUN_08035dd8 lines 1314-1321 (dual-copy SRAM write loop); baseline.sav bytes [0xA40,0xA4A) equal bytes [0x0C,0x16).
fields.name: state_flags_0c_mirror
